items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Tiny Parm you just finished playing? He said yes. I said what was the name of it? He said Frogtown Blues.

ctx.x: Petita hit anything you know. So this particular session, it was drums, guitar, organ and playing it. Tiny Parm dies three months later. Never did hear the record. So I had AAF station in Chicago and they played this record and I said I recognized my own, he said I don't recognize the organ. So I called him and asked him, I said is that a Decker record, Tiny Parm you just finished playing? He said yes. I said what was the name of it? He said Frogtown Blues. You know? That's the first I knew what it was.
And there's two more I never did.
